title: Security tightened in Jammu and Kashmir ahead of Article 370 abrogation anniversary
summary: The Indian government has announced heightened security measures in Jammu and Kashmir ahead of the one-year anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370. The state police have banned unauthorized protests, while the Amarnath Yatra convoys have been suspended as a precautionary measure. The opposition parties have announced Black Day protests to mark the occasion. The government has called for calm and urged citizens to cooperate with security forces.
summary_points: The Indian government has announced heightened security measures in Jammu and Kashmir ahead of the one-year anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370.
The state police have banned unauthorized protests, while the Amarnath Yatra convoys have been suspended as a precautionary measure.
The opposition parties have announced Black Day protests to mark the occasion.
The government has called for calm and urged citizens to cooperate with security forces.

center: Outlets have emphasized the importance of maintaining law and order in Jammu and Kashmir, citing the need for security measures.
The government claimed that the protests were being organized by external forces to destabilize the region.
Repeated the opposition's demand for a court-monitored audit of the abrogation process.
right: Outlets have highlighted the role of the opposition parties in organizing protests and alleged that they are trying to incite violence.
The government said that the security measures were necessary to prevent any potential threat to national security.
Emphasized the significance of the abrogation anniversary as a major milestone in Jammu and Kashmir's history.
